# MM-P2-L2-RR03 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Scope
This document describes routine preventive maintenance and critical adjustment procedures for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03). It covers pre-maintenance safety checks, required tools, stepwise maintenance actions for the mandrel clamp and main roll bearing lubrication, acceptance criteria for return to service, and records to retain. Procedures reference SB-1049 and SOP-P2-L2-03 for safety and lockout practices, and SOP-P2-L2-05 for lubrication material selection and handling.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated to the range appropriate for mandrel clamp bolts and fitted with a compatible drive and socket for the clamp hardware. Ensure calibration certificate available before use.
- Clean lint-free rags and approved solvent per SOP-P2-L2-05 for cleaning bearing surfaces.
- Grease gun compatible with lubrication fittings specified in SOP-P2-L2-05.
- Dial indicator or runout measurement device for mandrel alignment verification.
- Personal protective equipment as required by SB-1049 and SOP-P2-L2-03.

Procedure
Background and rationale
The mandrel clamp secures the mandrel during rolling operations; correct clamp bolt preload is critical to prevent mandrel slippage and maintain ring geometry. The main roll bearing requires a scheduled lubrication frequency to preserve lubricant film, minimize wear, and prevent bearing failure. The following tasks focus on ensuring correct clamp torque and maintaining the main roll bearing lubrication according to the specified interval and industry best practices.

Pre-maintenance actions
- Confirm work authorization and permit requirements in accordance with SB-1049 and SOP-P2-L2-03. Verify that the equipment is isolated and locked out per SOP-P2-L2-03 before any work near moving components.
- Review last maintenance record and confirm that the next scheduled lubrication is due based on operating logs and the interval specified below.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque adjustment
- Clean the mandrel clamp area of oil and debris with approved solvent. Wipe with lint-free rag and inspect for wear or damage.
- Hand-tighten each clamp bolt in a star pattern until snug to seat the clamp uniformly.
- Using the calibrated torque wrench, apply torque to each clamp bolt to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m.
- After applying torque, allow a short settling period, then re-check each bolt to confirm torque retention. If torque loss is observed, inspect threads and mating surfaces for damage and correct before re-torquing.
- Verify mandrel runout at the specified inspection points and compare to baseline measurements in the equipment history record. Adjust clamp position if runout exceeds historical baseline values.

Main roll bearing lubrication
- Confirm lubricant type and quantity per SOP-P2-L2-05. Prepare grease gun and purge air from the delivery system to ensure consistent flow.
- The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 185 hours. Document operating hours since the last lubrication in the maintenance log prior to replenishment.
- Clean grease fittings and surrounding area to prevent contamination. Apply lubricant until fresh grease is observed at the bearing seals or until resistance indicates the cavity is adequately filled as described in SOP-P2-L2-05.
- Wipe away excess lubricant and inspect for signs of leakage or seal degradation. Record the quantity dispensed and any anomalies observed.

Examples and troubleshooting
- Example: If clamp bolts repeatedly lose torque, inspect for elongated bolt holes, damaged threads, or inadequate clamp seating. Replace defective hardware and re-establish torque to the specified value.
- Example: If bearing temperatures rise after lubrication, verify lubricant compatibility per SOP-P2-L2-05, inspect for contamination, and check for misalignment or excessive preload. Refer to SB-1049 for hot-work and thermal safety guidance during diagnosis.
- If grease fitting is blocked, use approved fitting cleaning tools and re-test delivery before applying lubricant. If blockage persists, replace the fitting and record the replacement action in the maintenance log.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts must hold the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m. Torque readings must remain within tool calibration tolerance after settling. No visible mechanical damage or plastic deformation of clamp components is acceptable.
- Mandrel runout must be within historical baseline limits recorded in the equipment history. Any deviation that exceeds baseline limits requires inspection and corrective action before return to service.
- Main roll bearing lubrication must be performed in accordance with the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 185 hours. Bearings must show consistent, smooth rotation with no abnormal noise on manual spin and no signs of lubricant contamination or leakage.
- No safety interlocks or guards shall be bypassed during maintenance. Equipment must pass pre-start checks in SOP-P2-L2-03 before resumption of operations.

Records to keep
- Maintenance work order documenting mandrel clamp torque application, including torque tool ID and calibration status, and the exact torque value applied as specified above.
- Lubrication log entry showing operating hours at time of lubrication, lubricant type per SOP-P2-L2-05, quantity dispensed, and technician initials.
- Inspection notes for mandrel runout and any corrective actions taken. Attach photos where applicable.
- References to related documents: SB-1049, SOP-P2-L2-03, SOP-P2-L2-05.

Revision control and feedback
Record any deviations, part replacements, or process improvements in the equipment maintenance history and propose updates to this document through the document control process. Technical feedback and nonconformance reports should reference this document id: MM-P2-L2-RR03 and be submitted per plant document control procedures.
